from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,datetime
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
base=Path.cwd();out=base/'reports/research/510300_electricity_composition_failure_attribution_v1'
parent=base/'reports/research/510300_electricity_composition_joint_score_v1'
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (out/'result.json').exists()
for p in protocol['source_receipts']:assert hashlib.sha256((base/p['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p['sha256']
def clean(v):
    if isinstance(v,(pd.Timestamp,datetime.datetime)):return v.isoformat()
    if isinstance(v,np.generic):return clean(v.item())
    if isinstance(v,float) and not np.isfinite(v):return None
    if isinstance(v,dict):return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
    if isinstance(v,(list,tuple)):return [clean(x) for x in v]
    return v
def save(name,v):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(clean(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
events=pd.read_parquet(parent/'全部51原公告_标签复用与预热保留.parquet').set_index('event_id',drop=False)
pred=pd.read_parquet(parent/'逐原公告联合评分.parquet').set_index('event_id',drop=False)
models=json.loads((parent/'全部39次保存模型与实际决策路径.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
leaves=[];member_rows=[];identity=0
def walk(tree,row):
    fields=tree['features'];x=row[fields].to_numpy(np.float32);node=0
    while tree['feature'][node]>=0:
        j=tree['feature'][node];node=tree['children_left'][node] if float(x[j])<=tree['threshold'][node] else tree['children_right'][node]
    return node
for item in models:
    current=pred.loc[item['event_id']]
    pool=events.loc[item['training_event_ids']]
    assert pool.exit_idx.max()<=current.state_idx and pool.state_idx.max()<current.state_idx
    for name,tree in item['models'].items():
        if name.endswith('_ridge'):
            x=current[tree['features']].to_numpy(float);p=float(tree['ymean']+(np.clip((x-np.array(tree['mean']))/np.array(tree['scale']),-5,5)-np.array(tree['zmean']))@np.array(tree['coef']))
            assert abs(p-current[name+'_prediction'])<1e-12
            identity+=1
            continue
        node=walk(tree,current);p=float(tree['value'][node])
        assert abs(p-current[name+'_prediction'])<1e-12 and node==tree['current_leaf']
        identity+=1
        membership=pd.Series([walk(tree,r) for _,r in pool.iterrows()],index=pool.index)
        for leaf in sorted(set(membership)):
            group=pool[membership.eq(leaf)]
            mean=float(group.actual_net5.mean())
            assert len(group)==tree['samples'][leaf] and abs(mean-tree['value'][leaf])<1e-12
            max_id=group.actual_net5.abs().idxmax();extreme=group.loc[max_id]
            absolute_sum=float(group.actual_net5.abs().sum())
            signed_sum=float(group.actual_net5.sum())
            rec={'event_id':current.event_id,'era':current.era,'decision_at':current.decision_at,'model':name,'leaf':int(leaf),'on_current_path':leaf==node,'leaf_n':len(group),'leaf_mean_net5':mean,'largest_abs_member_event_id':max_id,'largest_abs_member_entry_date':extreme.entry_date,'largest_abs_member_exit_date':extreme.exit_date,'largest_abs_member_net5':float(extreme.actual_net5),'largest_abs_fraction_of_abs_sum':float(abs(extreme.actual_net5)/absolute_sum) if absolute_sum else None,'largest_abs_fraction_of_signed_sum':float(extreme.actual_net5/signed_sum) if signed_sum else None,'members':group.event_id.tolist()}
            leaves.append(rec)
            for _,r in group.iterrows():
                member_rows.append({'current_event_id':current.event_id,'current_era':current.era,'model':name,'leaf':int(leaf),'on_current_path':leaf==node,'training_event_id':r.event_id,'training_decision_at':r.decision_at,'training_exit_idx':int(r.exit_idx),'current_state_idx':int(current.state_idx),'training_entry_date':r.entry_date,'training_exit_date':r.exit_date,'training_net5':float(r.actual_net5)})
assert identity==156
save('全部保存叶组_极端成员与当前路径.json',leaves)
pd.DataFrame(member_rows).to_csv(out/'全部叶组原成熟成员_不删极端.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
op=pd.read_csv(parent/'全部固定高分自然机会.csv')
price=pd.read_parquet(base/'reports/research/510300_purchase_quantity_cause_increment_v1/原八变量与采购两列_原标签不变.parquet',columns=['idx','date','open']).set_index('idx')
div=pd.read_csv(base/'data/reference/510300_dividends.csv');div['record_date']=pd.to_datetime(div.record_date)
costs=[]
for _,r in op.iterrows():
    i=int(r.state_idx);entry=price.loc[i+1];exitrow=price.loc[int(r.exit_idx)]
    assert pd.Timestamp(entry.date)==pd.Timestamp(r.entry_date) and pd.Timestamp(exitrow.date)==pd.Timestamp(r.exit_date)
    entitlement=float(div.loc[div.record_date.ge(entry.date)&div.record_date.lt(exitrow.date),'cash_dividend_per_share'].sum())
    buy=float(np.ceil(float(entry.open)*1.001*1000-1e-9)/1000)
    sell=float(np.floor(float(exitrow.open)*.999*1000+1e-9)/1000)
    buyfee=max(5.,10000*buy*.0004);sellfee=max(5.,10000*sell*.0004)
    paid=10000*buy+buyfee;received=10000*(sell+entitlement)-sellfee
    original_identity=received/paid-1
    assert abs(original_identity-float(r.net_return))<1e-12
    gross=float((exitrow.open+entitlement)/entry.open-1)
    costs.append({**r.to_dict(),'entry_open':float(entry.open),'exit_open':float(exitrow.open),'dividend_entitlement_per_share':entitlement,'original_buy_after_slippage_and_tick':buy,'original_sell_after_slippage_and_tick':sell,'original_buy_commission_cny':buyfee,'original_sell_commission_cny':sellfee,'original_label_identity_recomputed':original_identity,'gross_same_event_zero_cost_explanatory_only':gross,'gross_minus_net_return':gross-float(r.net_return),'new_strategy':False})
cost=pd.DataFrame(costs)
assert len(cost)==len(op)==17
cost.to_csv(out/'全部17原机会_原费用身份与零费解释界.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
summaries=[]
for model in ['state8_tree','joint11_tree']:
    for era in ['2021—2023','2024—2025']:
        block=cost[cost.model.eq(model)&cost.era.eq(era)]
        summaries.append({'model':model,'era':era,'n':len(block),'mean_original_net5':float(block.net_return.mean()),'mean_same_event_zero_cost_gross':float(block.gross_same_event_zero_cost_explanatory_only.mean()),'mean_cost_effect_return':float(block.gross_minus_net_return.mean()),'mean_prediction':float(block.prediction.mean())})
primary_joint=cost[cost.model.eq('joint11_tree')&cost.era.eq('2024—2025')]
hi_ids=set(primary_joint.event_id)
actual_high_leaves=[x for x in leaves if x['model']=='joint11_tree' and x['on_current_path'] and x['event_id'] in hi_ids]
save('全部主要期高分当前叶组_完整训练成员.json',actual_high_leaves)
calibration=[{'event_id':r.event_id,'entry_date':r.entry_date,'prediction':float(r.prediction),'actual_net5':float(r.net_return),'prediction_minus_actual':float(r.prediction-r.net_return),'path':r.joint_actual_path_features} for _,r in primary_joint.iterrows()]
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E46','completed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone(datetime.timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat(),'status':'COMPLETED_SAVED_SIGNAL_COST_AND_LEAF_CONCENTRATION_ATTRIBUTION_NO_RETRAINING',
'saved_prediction_identity_checks_passed':identity,'original_fee_label_identity_checks_passed':len(cost),
'opportunity_cost_summaries':summaries,'primary_joint_prediction_and_realization':calibration,
'primary_joint_actual_path_only_funding_gap':bool(primary_joint.joint_actual_path_features.eq('资金利率与政策利率差').all()),
'primary_joint_high_score_leaf_concentration':actual_high_leaves,
'signal_diagnosis':'联合树主期高分平均净标签非正且逊同池均值，无新机会/无构成实际高分路径；费用前同原机会均值若非正则返费仍不足。叶组极端成熟标签贡献逐件保存，只解释估计结构，不识别经济因果。',
'account_diagnosis':'原固定信号门失败，200000/20000完整账户未运行，不能声称ES/50%仓位约束导致本批失败；主期自然机会仅2024年4/2025年3。',
'new_fits':0,'new_labels':0,'new_account_runs':0,'new_downloads':0,'source_code_edits':0,'no_outlier_removed':True,'no_new_threshold_or_forecast':True,'E45_rejection_unchanged':True,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET'}
save('result.json',result)
print(json.dumps(clean({'status':result['status'],'identities':identity,'fees_identity_n':len(cost),'summary':summaries,'primary_prediction_mean':primary_joint.prediction.mean(),'primary_current_leaves':actual_high_leaves}),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False))
